meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: Claude 会按先后步骤检查 AKS 集群、安装控制器、评估 GPU、选择并安装推理服务、部署第一个模型并做总结；每一步会汇报集群状态，安装或部署前会先征求你的确认。

howto.what_en: Claude runs through the setup in order: verifies the AKS cluster, installs the controller, assesses GPUs, sets up an inference provider, deploys the first model, and summarizes. It reports cluster status at each step and asks for confirmation before installs or deployments.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like “setup AI Runway”, “install AI Runway”, or “deploy model to AKS”, or ask to deploy a model to AKS.
